new_material_candidates.name: XSkill — Continual Learning from Experience and Skills in Multimodal Agents
new_material_candidates.material_reason: Adds a distinct continual-agent mechanism that jointly accumulates action-level experiences and structured task-level skills from multimodal trajectories and retrieves/adapts both during later tool-using tasks without parametric training.
new_material_candidates.classification_reason: Classified as E1_AGENT because multi-step tool selection, orchestration, trajectory accumulation, and action generation are material dependencies; visual input alone does not convert the method into a generic E3 vision comparator.

reference_or_screened.name: D2Skill — Dynamic Dual-Granularity Skill Bank for Agentic RL
reference_or_screened.relevance: Maintains task-level and step-level skills and jointly evolves the policy and skill bank using interaction-derived utility signals.
reference_or_screened.reason: The verified evidence is a public preprint with executable code, while the current E1 pool already contains stronger archival skill-library and skill-evolution comparators including SAGE and Skill-Pro. This bounded review did not verify an archival peer-reviewed publication that would alter the retained claim-bearing set.

reference_or_screened.name: COSPLAY — Co-Evolving LLM Decision and Skill Bank Agents
reference_or_screened.relevance: Co-evolves an LLM decision agent and a skill-bank agent from unlabeled interaction rollouts.
reference_or_screened.reason: No archival publication and governed executable implementation were verified in this pass, and the mechanism substantially overlaps the already populated E1 skill-bank/evolution comparison class.
